articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Deepak Tijori talks about making a comeback in films as actor-director with Tipppsy
articles.excerpt: In a long-form interview ahead of Tipppsy's release, Deepak Tijori opens up on returning to acting and direction after years away, his access to peers like Shah Rukh and Aamir Khan, and how the new generation of stars is now firewalled behind agencies.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Deepak Tijori ECSTATIC for his first ever nomination in his 35-year-old career for Echoes Of Us; breaks silence on 90s snubs
articles.excerpt: Tijori reflects on never being nominated through Aashiqui, Sadak, Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar and Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa, and what his first-ever award nod for the short film 'Echoes of Us' means after 35 years in cinema.

articles.title: Iulia Vantur turns heads in gold as Echoes Of Us wins big at Dadasaheb Phalke Awards 2026
articles.excerpt: Joe Rajan's short film Echoes of Us, starring Deepak Tijori and Iulia Vantur, took top honours at the 11th Dadasaheb Phalke Awards in Mumbai, capping a record festival run.

articles.title: Iulia Vantur Wins Global Acclaim for 'Echoes of Us,' Bags Multiple International Awards
articles.excerpt: Featuring Deepak Tijori opposite Iulia Vantur, Echoes of Us has amassed 88+ laurels and wins across festivals in Berlin, Singapore, Florida and Barcelona.

articles.title: 'Echoes of Us' makes history with triple win at Florida film festival
articles.excerpt: The film swept all three major short-film prizes at SAIFFF Florida 2026, with Deepak Tijori winning Best Actor (Short Film) opposite Iulia Vantur's Best Actress.

articles.title: South Asian International Film Festival Florida 2026 Concludes with Echoes of Us Sweeping Top Short Film Honors
articles.excerpt: Festival report on Echoes of Us's clean sweep at SAIFFF, with detail on the film's themes of grief and emotional neglect and Tijori's performance.

articles.title: EXPLOSIVE: Deepak Tijori BLASTS CBFC for 'TORTURING' him during the certification of Tipppsy
articles.excerpt: Tijori takes the censor board to task over what he calls a months-long bureaucratic ordeal during Tipppsy's certification — including a much-quoted misreading of 'pennies' as 'penis'.

articles.title: BREAKING: Deepak Tijori's Tipppsy to release in cinemas on May 10; trailer to be out on May 2
articles.excerpt: Release date and trailer drop confirmed for Tijori's directorial comeback, produced by Raju Chadha and Deepak Tijori, distributed by Panorama Studios.

articles.title: Trailer of Deepak Tijori's directorial 'Tipppsy' out, Pooja Bhatt gives shoutout
articles.excerpt: Pooja Bhatt and Mahesh Bhatt joined the trailer launch of Tipppsy in Mumbai, with Bhatt publicly endorsing Tijori's directorial return after a long break.

articles.title: Deepak Tijori Tipppsy Movie Exclusive Interview: Reveals Why He Did Not Cast Any Female Super Stars
articles.excerpt: Tijori on his casting philosophy, age-appropriate roles ('If De Niro and Pacino can do it, why can't we?'), and the conditions newer A-listers attach to projects.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Deepak Tijori opens up on the status of his directorial ventures, Tipppsy and Tom Dick And Harry 2
articles.excerpt: Tijori discusses his equation with the three Khans, the long road of Tipppsy, and the production complications that ultimately shelved Tom, Dick and Harry 2.

articles.title: Deepak Tijori reveals he spent his money to get featured on Aashiqui posters; admits he was a bigger star than Akshay Kumar during Khiladi
articles.excerpt: A career-spanning conversation in which Tijori revisits the early-90s peak — Aashiqui, Khiladi, Baazigar — and the self-funded poster placement that helped launch his run as a leading man.
